stories.title: Sacramento-area school district promotes AI literacy in the classroom
stories.simple_summary: A school district in Sacramento is teaching students about AI and how it works. They want young people to understand this technology that's becoming part of everyday life.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren in school, they're learning about AI earlier than previous generations did, which prepares them for jobs in the future.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg has an Instagzam
stories.simple_summary: Instagram changed its logo and the way its name looks. The new design looks quite different from what people are used to seeing.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a visual change that doesn't affect how the app works — just a new look for the brand.

stories.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
stories.simple_summary: Google is letting people remove the little sparkly watermark that appears on images, videos, and music created by its AI tools. A watermark is a tiny mark (like a signature on a painting) that shows something was made by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's AI to create images for your small business, you can now remove that AI watermark, though Google will still track it invisibly behind the scenes.

stories.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
stories.simple_summary: Google will keep an invisible watermark on AI-created files even when you turn off the visible sparkly watermark. This invisible mark helps identify that something was made by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical clarification — it means Google can still prove a file came from their AI even when you remove the visible watermark.

stories.title: The unexpected issue dividing parties and midterms candidates
stories.simple_summary: The headline doesn't explain what the issue is, so we can't tell you what's really happening here.
stories.why_it_matters: Without more details, we can't say whether this affects you.

stories.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
stories.simple_summary: Mark Zuckerberg released a new AI tool that anyone can download and use on their own computer. He says AI should be available to everyone, not just locked up by big companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people interested in AI development — most small business owners won't download and run AI software on their own computers.

stories.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
stories.simple_summary: A company called Kog is working on making AI run faster on certain computer hardware that some people thought wasn't suitable for this job. This is mostly about technical computer improvements.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to engineers and data center companies — nothing you need to worry about in your daily life or business.

stories.title: Amazon and Alphabet’s Profits Reveal Circular Nature of A.I. Boom
stories.simple_summary: Amazon and Alphabet (Google's parent company) are making large profits from selling AI services and technology. The article looks at why the AI boom is profitable for these companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows these big companies are making money from AI, but doesn't change how you'd use AI in your business.

stories.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
stories.simple_summary: Natural gas prices might triple in some parts of the country. Big tech companies that run AI data centers (huge computer facilities) use a lot of natural gas for electricity, so their bills could become very expensive.
stories.why_it_matters: If natural gas prices rise, it could make AI services more expensive for everyone, which might raise prices for small businesses that use AI tools.

stories.title: Meta’s ‘open’ AI, and a $250M deal gone very wrong
stories.simple_summary: Meta released a free AI model people can download and use. The company also made a deal (mentioned as "gone wrong") but the details aren't explained in the headline.
stories.why_it_matters: The free AI tool part doesn't affect most small business owners, and without knowing what deal went wrong, we can't say if it matters to you.

stories.title: Not Micron, Not Sandisk. This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock Could Be the Next Nvidia.
stories.simple_summary: This is an advertisement suggesting you invest in a particular memory chip company, comparing it to Nvidia (a hugely profitable AI chip maker). Without seeing the full article, we can't evaluate if this is real advice or hype.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an investment tip for people with money in the stock market — nothing relevant to running a small business or everyday life.

stories.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
stories.simple_summary: Apple created a custom AI system designed specifically for the Chinese market. It worked with a Chinese company called Alibaba to build and train this AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important for people doing business in China or interested in international tech partnerships — it doesn't change how AI works for regular users or most small business owners.
